messages.subject: regex basics in R
parts:
Hello all;

i am writing a program which extracts the day, hour, minutes etc from
a timeoint variable.


the variable values are usually of the form, 'Per 1, 24 hours 30 min'
or 'Day 10, predose'.


i know how regular expressions work in SAS but can't say the same
with
R.


could someone kindly explain the basics of regex in R or point me
towards a resource for the same?


i have gone through the help pages but don't have a clear idea about
how the expressions are defined and how the numbers corresponding to
these tokens can be extracted.


any help, especially examples would be greatly appreciated.


thanks and regards


Nikhil
